:::

`boolean`

[Default]{.arg-key} `true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--max_iter`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Maximum number of iterations for the SVM.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `5000`

[Min]{.arg-key} `1`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--c_reg`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Regularization parameter for the SVM.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `1.0`

[Min]{.arg-key} `0.0`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--class_weight`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
"Class weights for the SVM.  The `uniform` mode gives all classes a weight  of one.
The `balanced` mode (default) uses the values of y to automatically adjust weights inversely
proportional to class frequencies in the input data as n_samples / (n_classes * np.bincount(y))"
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"balanced"`

[Choices]{.arg-key} `"balanced"`, `"uniform"`
:::
::::
:::::

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/annotate/svm_annotation/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline/v4.2.0/components/annotate/svm_annotation);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/annotate/svm_annotation/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
